categories.name: Leather Welding Gloves
categories.summary: OEM/ODM leather welding gloves for distributors and importers who need cuff length, lining, reinforcement, stitching and target standard discussions before quotation.
categories.zhSummary: 面向分销商和进口商的 OEM/ODM 皮革焊接手套，询价前可确认袖口长度、内里、补强、车线和目标标准。
categories.materials: Split cowhide, selected grain leather or mixed leather construction can be discussed by application. Exact leather grade and thickness are confirmed by sample and buyer requirement.
categories.zhMaterials: 可按用途讨论牛二层皮、头层皮或组合皮结构。具体皮料等级和厚度以样品和买家要求确认为准。
categories.construction: Long cuff, palm reinforcement, lining, welted seams and heat-resistant thread are configurable where the buyer provides target use and market.
categories.zhConstruction: 长袖口、掌面补强、内里、包缝和耐热线等配置，可按买家用途和目标市场确认。
categories.uses: MIG welding, TIG welding, arc welding, fabrication, metal work and heat-adjacent handling where leather glove construction is appropriate.
categories.zhUses: MIG、TIG、手工电弧焊、金属加工及适合皮革手套结构的热源周边搬运。
categories.custom: Logo, cuff color, lining, reinforcement, label, bag and carton mark can be discussed after product direction is selected.
categories.zhCustom: 选定产品方向后，可讨论 Logo、袖口颜色、内里、补强、标签、袋装和外箱唛头。

categories.name: Leather Driver Gloves
categories.summary: Leather driver gloves for logistics, material handling and general industrial supply programs that need fit, thumb style, leather selection and branding options.
categories.zhSummary: 用于物流、物料搬运和工业供应项目的皮革司机手套，可按贴合度、拇指结构、皮料和品牌定制讨论。
categories.materials: Grain cowhide, split leather or other leather options should be selected by grip, wear area, flexibility and price target.
categories.zhMaterials: 头层牛皮、二层皮或其他皮料选项，应按抓握、磨损区域、灵活性和目标价格带选择。
categories.construction: Driver pattern, elastic back, thumb style, binding and common wear-area reinforcement are buyer-selectable.
categories.zhConstruction: 司机手套版型、松紧背、拇指结构、包边和常见磨损区域补强可按买家要求选择。
categories.uses: Driving, logistics, warehouse work, light fabrication and general handling.
categories.zhUses: 驾驶、物流、仓储、轻加工和通用搬运。
categories.custom: Leather color, logo mark, cuff binding, size run, hang tag and packaging language can be discussed.
categories.zhCustom: 可讨论皮料颜色、Logo、袖口包边、尺码段、吊牌和包装语言。

categories.name: Semi-Leather Work Gloves
categories.summary: Semi-leather work gloves combining leather wear areas with textile backs for construction, logistics and cost-sensitive safety supply.
categories.zhSummary: 半皮劳保手套把皮革耐磨区域和布背结合，适合建筑、物流和价格敏感型劳保供应。
categories.materials: Leather palm or wear panels with textile back. Leather commercial grade should be confirmed against sample, feel, usable area and defect tolerance.
categories.zhMaterials: 皮掌或易磨区域配布背。皮料商业等级需结合样品、手感、可用面积和瑕疵容忍度确认。
categories.construction: Palm patch, knuckle strip, safety cuff and fabric color are typical configurable parts.
categories.zhConstruction: 掌贴、指关节条、安全袖口和布背颜色是常见可配置部位。
categories.uses: Construction supply, warehouse handling, farm work and general industrial handling.
categories.zhUses: 建筑供应、仓库搬运、农用作业和通用工业搬运。
categories.custom: Logo print, fabric color, cuff type, leather coverage and packing can be discussed.
categories.zhCustom: 可讨论 Logo 印刷、布料颜色、袖口类型、皮革覆盖面积和包装。

categories.name: Long Cuff Pet Handling Gloves
categories.summary: Long cuff leather handling gloves for special handling scenarios where sleeve length, lining and cleaning expectations must be confirmed before quotation.
categories.zhSummary: 长袖口皮革防护手套用于特殊处理场景，报价前需确认袖长、内里和清洁要求。
categories.materials: Leather shell with lining options. Risk level should be evaluated by the buyer; no glove should be represented as bite-proof without validated evidence.
categories.zhMaterials: 皮革外层配可选内里。风险等级应由买家评估；没有验证证据时，不声称防咬。
categories.construction: Extended cuff, lining, palm thickness and cuff closure are the main points to confirm.
categories.zhConstruction: 加长袖口、内里、掌面厚度和袖口收口是主要确认点。
categories.uses: Pet grooming support, animal handling support and special protective handling where leather coverage is requested.
categories.zhUses: 宠物美容辅助、动物处理辅助及需要皮革覆盖的特殊防护搬运。
categories.custom: Length, lining, color, label, packing and warning copy can be discussed.
categories.zhCustom: 可讨论长度、内里、颜色、标签、包装和警示说明。
